name: Andreas Schieder - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Albania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is giving its opinion on how Albania is doing in its bid to join the European Union. It praises Albania for supporting the EU's foreign policy and for starting membership talks on some policy areas. It asks Albania to do more to fight corruption and organised crime, protect journalists and free media, improve elections, and protect minorities, women and the environment. It also calls on the EU to keep supporting Albania with money and practical help.

- The report sets no legal changes; it lists reforms Albania should make.
- It affects Albania's government, courts, media and citizens, plus EU support.
- Next, the Parliament sends its views to EU institutions and Albania's leaders.
